values.goal: Provide a narrow typed CAS-guarded operator operation to revoke an abandoned active claim without waiting for lease expiry or hand-editing canonical state.
values.required_outcome: A schema-visible csdlc-bind revoke route, atomic claim clearing, audit evidence, and focused fail-closed tests.
authority_boundary: Only an explicit operator-authorized request may revoke a live claim; ordinary expiry recovery and closeout remain unchanged.
